interpretation.nested_spans: All spans are inclusive; nested times overlap and must not be summed.
interpretation.cpu_wall: CPU wall around a CUDA call includes Python launch and any synchronization/D2H in that call.
interpretation.cuda_event: Paired events are queued asynchronously and resolved after replay calls; spans include stream gaps.
interpretation.attention: MoT imports flash_attention, which calls scaled_dot_product_attention. Action-to-observation QK/AV has no native standalone timer; report the SDPA mixed-attention interval plus mask/shape FLOP estimates.
interpretation.text_cross_attention: Action block text cross-attention is separately timed as module.*cross_attn and is not the action-to-observation self-attention target.
interpretation.h2d: Native H2D sub-operations are identified only by profiler aten::to/copy and CUDA memcpy events; those trace timings are perturbative and are not native latency.
interpretation.video: IDM runs 10 video-only denoise calls and 10 video scheduler steps, freezes all denoised video tokens into a K/V cache, then runs 10 action denoise calls. Future pixels are not decoded. Detailed video Q/K/V and layer timings are stage-labelled to separate video denoising from conditional cache prefill.
interpretation.episode_env: environment.step and sim.render are nested inclusive wall spans; do not add them. A zero render hook count means sim.render was unavailable or could not be patched; environment.step remains inclusive.
